companies.name: Meridian Labs
companies.sector: Multi-agent AI customer-support platform for e-commerce sellers

system_charter.summary: Meridian Concierge: a multi-agent AI customer-support platform (intake-triage / resolution / escalation agents) for e-commerce sellers. Launched to automate first-line ticket handling — routing, refund proposals, and shipping-address changes — while keeping clearly-defined high-risk actions gated behind a human.
agent_behavior_boundaries: Refunds over $200 must be routed to human approval before execution.
Agent must never modify a customer's shipping address without a logged confirmation step.
key_risks_at_launch: Resolution agent over-trusting ambiguous refund requests

companies.name: Wayfinder AI
companies.sector: Multi-agent AI trip-planning and booking assistant

system_charter.summary: Wayfinder Copilot: a multi-agent trip-planning/booking assistant that recommends itineraries and completes bookings on a traveler's behalf, including non-refundable fares and reservations. Launched with an explicit customer-confirmation gate on any booking that can't be undone.
agent_behavior_boundaries: Agent must never confirm a non-refundable booking without an explicit customer confirmation step logged in the same session.
key_risks_at_launch: Booking agent completing a non-refundable purchase on ambiguous customer intent
Third-party booking-provider API instability during the confirmation window
Prompt-injection via a customer's free-text trip request

companies.name: Cascade Analytics
companies.sector: AI agent managing customer data pipelines

slo_agreement.summary: Cascade Pipeline Agent: an AI agent managing customer data pipelines (schema-inference / anomaly-detection / auto-remediation sub-agents). Tracked on monthly error-budget consumption for pipeline-run failures and incidents.

monthly_error_budget_consumed_pct.definition: Percentage of the monthly error budget consumed by pipeline run failures and incidents, tracked cumulatively within the calendar month

slo_agreement.reporting_frequency: Bi-weekly, within 3 business days of cycle-end
